name: marketing-announcements
title: Announcements
description: Top-of-page and floating notification bars for communicating promotions, product updates, or site-wide notices on marketing websites, with dismissable and fixed-position variants.
useWhen: Communicating a time-limited promotion, new feature launch, or site-wide notice without interrupting the main page flow.
Drawing attention to a critical update at the top of a marketing page before the hero section.
Showing a dismissable cookie or privacy notice at the bottom of the viewport.
avoidWhen: The message is permanent and critical — use an inline alert or dedicated page section instead.
The page already has a cookie banner or legal notice — stacking multiple announcement bars creates visual noise.
The announcement requires user action beyond a single CTA — use a modal or dedicated landing page.
responsiveBehavior: Announcements stack vertically on mobile and display inline on tablet and above. Fixed announcements account for the banner height in the page scroll offset.
accessibility: Use role='banner' or role='alert' depending on urgency; polite announcements use aria-live='polite'.
Dismiss buttons must have an aria-label such as 'Dismiss announcement' for screen reader users.
Ensure the announcement does not obscure page content when fixed-positioned — add body padding-top equal to banner height.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Simple inline announcement bar at the top of the page with a short message and optional link — the minimal pattern for promotion notices.
accessibility: Wrap in a <div role='alert'> or <aside> depending on whether the message is time-sensitive.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Inline announcement bar adapted for dark marketing page surfaces with dark background and light message text.
accessibility: Announcement text must meet WCAG AA contrast on the dark bar background.

variants.title: Base with dismiss
variants.description: Inline announcement bar with a dismiss (×) button allowing users to hide the notice and continue to the page.
accessibility: Dismiss button must have aria-label='Dismiss announcement'; after dismissal, focus should move to the next logical element.

variants.title: Base with dismiss (Dark)
variants.description: Dismissable inline announcement bar adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Dismiss icon and announcement text must meet contrast requirements on dark bar backgrounds.

variants.title: Fixed
variants.description: Announcement bar that sticks to the top of the viewport as the user scrolls — for promotions that must remain visible throughout the page experience.
accessibility: Fixed bars must not cover interactive page content; apply equivalent padding-top to the page body.

variants.title: Fixed (Dark)
variants.description: Fixed-position announcement bar adapted for dark marketing sites, remaining visible at the top of the viewport while scrolling.
accessibility: Dark fixed bar must have a solid background so it visually separates from scrolled page content beneath.

variants.title: Fixed with dismiss
variants.description: Fixed-position announcement bar with a dismiss button, letting users permanently hide the notice while scrolling.
accessibility: Dismiss button must be keyboard-focusable; after dismiss, remove the bar from DOM so it no longer occupies space.

variants.title: Fixed with dismiss (Dark)
variants.description: Fixed dismissable announcement bar adapted for dark marketing sites.
accessibility: Dismiss button contrast and announcement text must meet WCAG AA on the dark fixed bar.

variants.title: Floating
variants.description: Floating notification bar that appears above the page content without affecting layout flow — ideal for cookie notices and limited-time offers.
accessibility: Floating bars must not cover keyboard focus indicators; use z-index carefully to avoid overlapping interactive elements.

variants.title: Floating (Dark)
variants.description: Floating announcement adapted for dark marketing surfaces, appearing above page content without disrupting the layout.
accessibility: Floating dark bar must have a visible shadow or border to differentiate it from the page background.

variants.title: Floating with dismiss
variants.description: Floating announcement bar with a dismiss button — the standard pattern for cookie consent notices and non-blocking promotional popups.
accessibility: Dismissable floating bars should use role='dialog' with aria-label if they interrupt the page flow on appearance.

variants.title: Floating with dismiss (Dark)
variants.description: Floating dismissable announcement bar adapted for dark marketing pages.
accessibility: Dismiss icon and text must meet contrast requirements on the dark floating bar background.
